description: reStructuredText language support (RST/ReST linter, preview, IntelliSense and more)
restructuredtext.styles.dec: A list of URLs or local paths to CSS style sheets to use from the restructuredtext preview. Relative paths are interpreted relative to the folder open in the explorer. If there is no open folder, they are interpreted relative to the location of the restructuredtext file. All '\' need to be written as '\\'.

config.list.indentationSize.description:
List indentation scheme. (Also affects TOC generation.)

Whether to use different indentation sizes on different list contexts or stick to VS Code's tab size.
config.list.indentationSize.enumDescript:
Adaptive indentation size according to the context, trying to **left align the sublist with its parent's content**. For example:

```markdown
- Parent
  - Sublist

1. Parent
   1. Sublist

10. Parent with longer marker
    1. Sublist
```

Use the configured tab size of the current document (see the status bar). For example (with `tabSize: 4`):

```markdown
- Parent
    - Sublist

1. Parent
    1. Sublist

10. Parent with longer marker
    1. Sublist
```
config.orderedList.marker.enumDescriptio: Always use `1.` as ordered list marker.
Use increasing numbers as ordered list marker.
config.editor.ime.suppressKeyBindings.de: Temporarily suppress reStructuredText `Enter` and `Backspace` keybindings while you are using an IME or other composition-based input method. Command-based list editing remains available.
config.formatter.normalizeSectionUnderli: Normalize section underline and overline widths to the display width of the title text. This follows docutils-style section width calculation for Unicode text.
config.formatter.normalizeSectionSpacing: Insert a blank line before and after section titles when surrounding content would otherwise run together.
Trim trailing spaces and tabs while formatting reStructuredText documents.
config.formatter.maxConsecutiveBlankLine: Maximum number of consecutive blank lines the formatter preserves.
